verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is a SaaS equity-management platform, and opting out of telemetry, analytics or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for any web SaaS product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry controls, cookie or analytics opt-outs, or usage-tracking settings. The pack covers only cap-table, data-room, workflow and integration features, so the verdict is none rather than na.
